title: UniDot: A Unified Network for Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in Large-scale Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial recommenders rely on two model families that have evolved largely independently: feature-interaction models over multi-field user/item features, and sequential models over user-behavior histories. Production systems couple them only loosely. To unify the two, we present UniDot, a novel architecture for post-click conversion prediction built from the factorization-machine (FM) point of view: the embedding inner product---which powers collaborative filtering and lets a recommender generalize to unseen user--item pairs---is the same primitive as attention's query dot key scoring, so a single dot-product of tokens can underlie both feature interaction and sequence modeling. translated_title: UniDot：大规模推荐中序列建模与特征交互的统一网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16797v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：工业推荐系统依赖于两个基本独立演进的模型家族：基于多字段用户/物品特征的特征交互模型，以及基于用户行为历史的序列模型。生产系统仅将它们松散耦合。为统一两者，我们提出了UniDot，一种从因子分解机（FM）视角构建的点击后转化预测新架构：嵌入内积——它驱动协同过滤并让推荐器泛化到未见过的用户-物品对——与注意力机制中的查询-键点积评分是同一原语，因此单个token点积可以同时支撑特征交互和序列建模。UniDot将非序列字段和多域行为序列分词为共享的token空间，并堆叠一个单一宏块，其中token混合总线（token-mixing bus）和序列检索总线（sequence-retrieval bus，物品token交叉关注历史）并行运行。
tldr: UniDot通过将特征交互和序列建模统一为共享的点积机制，提出了一种基于FM视角的新型架构，实现了两者的并行融合，提升了点击后转化预测的效率。
en_tdlr: UniDot unifies feature interaction and sequence modeling through a shared dot-product mechanism, proposing a novel FM-inspired architecture that runs them in parallel, enhancing post-click conversion prediction.
